name: decisioncraft
description: Point it at anything and get as-is against to-be, the gaps as user stories, and a sticky note from every role.
long_description: Point Decisioncraft at anything (a codebase, meeting notes, a process or a personal choice) and you get a map of as-is against to-be, the gaps written as user stories, and a sticky note from every role. It's rigorous decision analysis in plain language, from a quick side-by-side to a full team review. Canvases are single offline HTML files. In Claude Desktop the drawing is done by Claude itself; an Anthropic or OpenAI key is optional.

tools.name: decisioncraft_discover
tools.description: Begin with a few questions about the choice, why it matters and a useful visual.

tools.name: decisioncraft_templates
tools.description: Get supported map shapes and the writing guide for the host's own model.

tools.name: decisioncraft_validate
tools.description: Check a model before opening it.

tools.name: decisioncraft_start_review
tools.description: Open a browser review.

tools.name: decisioncraft_wait_for_review
tools.description: Wait briefly for Finish review, then return answers and the completed handoff.

tools.name: decisioncraft_render
tools.description: Draw a model as one offline HTML canvas and return where it was written.

tools.name: decisioncraft_words
tools.description: The whole model as readable Markdown, for people who prefer text or for reading back.

tools.name: decisioncraft_questions
tools.description: Every question to decide, most urgent first; reviewers' dots and answers change the order.

tools.name: decisioncraft_merge
tools.description: Combine saved reviews: agree and disagree counts, dots, comments and conflicts.

tools.name: decisioncraft_diff
tools.description: What was added, removed and changed between two versions of a model.

tools.name: decisioncraft_example
tools.description: A worked example by id (map, car, business, technical, engineering or medical): model, material, reviews.

tools.name: decisioncraft_draft
tools.description: Draft a full model from material using this host's model (or the server's API key).

tools.name: decisioncraft_perspectives
tools.description: Add notes from each role to a model using this host's model (or the server's API key).

tools.name: decisioncraft_review_notes
tools.description: Get expert replies on reviewers' rough notes using this host's model.

tools.name: decisioncraft_map
tools.description: Point it at anything: a repo or folder path, a notes file, a web page's text, or a topic.

tools.name: decisioncraft_triage
tools.description: How much help a choice needs: none (just answer), quick, guided or team.

tools.name: decisioncraft_quick
tools.description: Quick mode: score options against what matters; returns a table, a lean and one check.

tools.name: decisioncraft_interview_next
tools.description: Guided mode: record the answer and get the next question.

tools.name: decisioncraft_handoff
tools.description: Read a completed review as answers, proposed stories, checks and a proposed map.

tools.name: decisioncraft_close_review
tools.description: Close a browser review after reading its handoff.

prompts.name: map_this
prompts.description: Show how something works today, what could be better, and what each role thinks.

prompts.name: decide
prompts.description: Help someone think a choice through, at the right depth.

prompts.name: compare_options
prompts.description: Lay options side by side against what matters, in the conversation.

prompts.name: what_could_go_wrong
prompts.description: A pre-mortem: imagine it went badly and work out why, then guard against it.

prompts.name: regret_test
prompts.description: How each option is likely to feel in 10 days, 10 months and 10 years.

prompts.name: review_canvas
prompts.description: Walk someone through a Decisioncraft canvas and collect their answers.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only used if Claude Desktop can't run a step itself. Leave empty to let Claude do the drawing.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Optional alternative to the Anthropic key.
